admin.intro: Herald sends bulk email and newsletters to your members, the way Invision Community does. Mailings are written on the forum itself — in your forum's own editor or the newsletter builder — so open Herald there to write one.
admin.batch_size_help: How many emails go out in each batch. Lower this if your mail provider limits how fast you can send.
admin.batch_delay_help: A pause between batches, for mail providers with an hourly limit. 0 sends as fast as the server can.
admin.reply_to_help: Where replies to a mailing go. Leave empty to use the forum's sending address.
admin.sending_help: While you watch the progress screen, your browser keeps the send moving. To let it continue after you close the page, run a queue worker, or add Flarum's scheduler to cron:
admin.limit_help: Your mail provider's sending limits, shared by every mailing. A send that reaches one pauses and carries on when there is room again. Leave empty or 0 for no limit.
admin.signup_help: A box members and guests can use to subscribe, for Bespoke and FoF Forum Widgets. Place it from your widget layout. Leave the wording empty to use the defaults shown.
admin.guest_signup_help: Guests enter an email address and confirm it from their inbox before anything is sent to them. Members always use their own switch.

forum.no_permission: You do not have permission to send bulk email.

schedule.help: Any time from five minutes to a year ahead. Until then you can still edit it, or unschedule it.
schedule.repeat_help: Each issue is a mailing of its own, with its own delivery record, sent at this time in this time zone — clocks changing included. The audience is counted again each time.

progress.background: You can leave this page. Sending carries on in the background.
progress.keep_open: Keep this page open until sending finishes. This forum has no queue worker or scheduled task to carry on without it.
progress.cancel_confirm: Stop sending? Members who have already been sent it keep their copy.
progress.limited: Paused: a sending limit has been reached. It carries on by itself when there is room.

deliveries.help: Failed copies are retried after 5 and then 30 minutes. Skipped: they opted out after you pressed Send. Unknown: the server stopped while handing it over, so it may have arrived — those are never resent automatically.
